name: Ezalm: Magic's Memory
storyline:
Decades had passed since humans were forced to abandon Sunderu, their ancestral homeland, to escape an invasion of creatures that had emerged from nowhere. But the peace they had hoped to find across the seas was short-lived, and the attacks struck the cities once again.

Freya is a formidable and experienced warrior as well as one of the defenders of the village of Ezalm, even though she is unable to use magic following an accident that occurred when she was young.

Her fate takes a dramatic turn the day she wakes up alone and, inexplicably, in Sunderu. As she travels through this unfamiliar land, she discovers a seyerite crystal that reawakens the power that lay dormant within her. Guided by this newly awakened magic, Freya then embarks on a perilous journey to find her way back to Ezalm.

Her journey will lead her to encounter forgotten peoples, uncover the buried secrets of her world, and defy the very forces of nature.

But as the truth unfolds, one question remains:
Would you jeopardize the balance of the world in order to get back where you belong?
summary: A narrative-driven action RPG where each spell you use will punish you, requiring you to be strategic in the combat styles you will build. Lost in the land of your ancestors, unravel the secrets of magic to return home and defend the people you swore to protect.
